tool_schemas.name: scrape_docs
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a documentation scrape job for the given URL and output_path, executes the scrape, and returns the resulting markdown artifact information for that job (including stored markdown content and any captured metadata/errors, if produced). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url or output_path is missing or not a string, and raises CONFLICT if output_path violates deduplication/safety constraints or is already reserved by an incompatible existing job. Raises NOT_FOUND when the target URL cannot be retrieved or resolved for scraping, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to create or update scrape jobs.

tool_schemas.name: list_scrape_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists scrape jobs in the authenticated workspace, optionally filtered by status, url host, and time range. Returns paginated results ordered by created_at desc. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid or revoked.

url_host.description: Filter jobs by parsed URL host (e.g., docs.example.com).

requested_output_path.description: Filter by requested output path (exact match).

created_after.description: Only include jobs created after this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

created_before.description: Only include jobs created before this time (RFC 3339 timestamp).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_scrape_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single scrape job by id within the authenticated workspace. Returns the job record including status, attempt counters, and timestamps. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist in the workspace.

tool_schemas.name: retry_scrape_job
tool_schemas.description: Retries a previously failed scrape job by transitioning it from failed back to queued and incrementing attempt by 1. Returns the updated job. Refuses with CONFLICT if the job is not in failed status, or if the workspace is suspended/deleted.

job_id.description: The scrape job id to retry.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_scrape_job
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-progress or queued scrape job by transitioning it to cancelled. Sets finished_at and duration_ms if started_at exists. Returns the updated job. Refuses with CONFLICT if the job is already succeeded/failed/cancelled.

job_id.description: The scrape job id to cancel.

tool_schemas.name: get_markdown_artifact
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the markdown artifact for a given scrape job. Returns artifact metadata and stored markdown content (when available). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the job has no artifact (e.g., failed/cancelled) or the id is not in the workspace.

job_id.description: The scrape job id whose artifact should be fetched.

include_content.description: When true, include the markdown bytes/content in the response; when false, return metadata only.

metadata.name: Doc Scraper
